topic: Sources of law in the absence of legislative text
text_ar: في حالة عدم وجود نص تشريعي يمكن تطبيقه، يحكم القاضي بمقتضى العرف، فإذا لم يوجد فبمقتضى مبادئ الشريعة الإسلامية، فإذا لم توجد فبمقتضى مبادئ القانون الطبيعي وقواعد العدالة.
text_en: In the absence of any applicable legislative text, the judge shall decide according to custom, and failing custom, according to the principles of Islamic law, and failing those, according to the principles of natural law and the rules of equity.

topic: The Effects of a Contract — pacta sunt servanda
text_ar: العقد شريعة المتعاقدين، فلا يجوز نقضه ولا تعديله إلا باتفاق الطرفين أو للأسباب التي يقررها القانون.
text_en: The contract makes the law of the parties. It can be revoked or altered only by mutual consent of both parties, or for reasons provided for by law.

topic: Performance of contracts in good faith
text_ar: يجب تنفيذ العقد طبقا لما اشتمل عليه وبطريقة تتفق مع ما يوجبه حسن النية.
text_en: A contract must be performed in accordance with its contents and in a manner consistent with the requirements of good faith.

topic: General rule of civil liability for wrongful acts
text_ar: كل خطأ سبب ضررا للغير يلزم من ارتكبه بالتعويض.
text_en: Any fault which causes damage to another obliges the person who committed it to make reparation.
[This article was repealed by a subsequent Presidential Decree; it is retained here, flagged, so the corpus does not silently have a gap that a RAG system might hallucinate around.]
